Hi Marissa,

Thanks again - we are excited to move forward with a Dedicated/Private demo focused on our EU and APAC regional requirements. Our DPO (Sofie Müller) and APAC security lead (Hiro Tanaka) will want to join for the security walkthrough and data-flow discussion.

To get this on the calendar, here are a couple windows that might work for our global team (all times shown with offsets; please confirm if I'm accounting for DST correctly):
- Option A: Wed, Jun 17 - 10:00 PDT / 19:00 CEST / Thu 03:00 JST (probably rough for APAC)
- Option B: Thu, Jun 18 - 08:00 PDT / 17:00 CEST / Thu 00:00 JST
- Option C: Thu, Jun 18 - 14:00 PDT / 23:00 CEST / Fri 07:00 JST

If none of those work, happy to share a Doodle / calendar poll. We can also loop in our procurement lead if we touch on pricing/commits.

Regards,
